description: This file provides a no-operation implementation of the OpenTelemetry metric API in Go, effectively disabling telemetry collection and minimizing resource usage. It defines various metric interfaces and their no-op implementations, along with a MeterProvider that returns no-op meters and instruments.

classes.description: A no-op implementation of the MeterProvider interface that returns no-op meters.
